about:
Washington Packaging Supply Co is based in Seattle, Washington. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders.

The company designs and manufactures a range of insulated packaging products, including box liners, pallet covers, gel saddlebags, air container liners, cargo blankets, ice blankets, container liners, and premium insulation under the Templok MM line (Templok MM Premium Insulation, Templok MM Pallet Covers, Templok MM Box Liners). Its patented design emphasizes high insulation value, water resistance, and ease of storage. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are provided.

The company does not specify the industries or customer types it serves in its public materials. Its product lineup suggests applications in cold-chain shipping, logistics, and temperature-sensitive product transport, with stated benefits of reducing product loss and keeping products clean.

Washington Packaging Supply Co highlights its patented design as a key differentiator, offering high insulation value, water resistance, and compact storage. The company positions its products to reduce product loss and keep products clean during transit.
